post.description: Adds a product to your catalog. `price_type` cannot change later. The payout is set per network and reaches new sessions only.

name.description: 1 to 200 characters, shown to the payer on the checkout.

description.description: 1 to 500 characters of plain text, shown under the name.

amount.description: USD, positive, at most two decimals and at most 10000000000000.00. Required for `fixed`, refused for `open`. Must settle on every network you accept in this mode: the fixed fee plus the percentage stays below it (0.11 USD with the pilot fee).

min_amount.description: Required for `open`. Same smallest settling amount as `amount`.

suggested_amounts.description: `open` only. Up to 3 amounts inside the range, shown as buttons to the payer.

payout.description: Keyed by network id. Each item is `{wallet_id, share}`: 1 to 5 distinct active wallets of the network family, shares above 0 with up to two decimals that add up to 100.00. `[]` drops a network (the same as `networks: {network: {"accept": "none"}}`). A network you leave out of both `payout` and `networks` pays your default wallet of its family at 100% and takes `all`, or is left unpaid when that family has no active wallet. The product must pay at least one network.

networks.description: Keyed by network id: which stablecoins the product takes there (D60). A network you leave out takes `all`. `all` or `some` without a `payout` for that network pays your default wallet of its family at 100% (400 when the family has no active wallet); `none` with a non-empty `payout` for the same network, or `all`/`some` with `payout: []`, is 400.

success_url.description: Default return URL for every session. Absolute, at most 2048 characters, `https` in live mode.

metadata.description: Default metadata, copied into every session. Up to 50 keys of 1 to 40 characters, string values of at most 500 characters.

patch.description: Send only what changes. Changes reach new sessions only: open sessions keep the amount and payout they started with.

amount.description: New price of a `fixed` product.

payout.description: Replaces the payout of the networks you send; the others stay. Each network takes 1 to 5 wallets, as on create, or `[]` to drop it.

networks.description: Replaces the choice of the networks you send; the others stay. Switching a network from `none` to `all` or `some` without a `payout` for it pays your default wallet of its family at 100% (400 when the family has no active wallet). `none` drops the network and its payout. Changing only the stablecoins moves no money, so it needs no `links` decision; open sessions keep what they offered.

metadata.description: `null` clears it. Up to 50 keys of 1 to 40 characters, string values of at most 500 characters.

active.description: Deactivating stops every link of the product. Reactivating checks the payout again.

links.description: What happens to the product's active links. Required when the edit changes `amount`, `min_amount`, `max_amount` or `payout` and the product has an active link: `keep` leaves them active (new checkouts use the new price; a link that sets its own amount keeps it, even outside a new range), `deactivate` deactivates every active link in the same transaction. Checkouts already open keep the old price and payout either way. Ignored otherwise; `null` counts as absent.

post.description: Opens one payment for one product. The session shows its networks, assets and amounts without any deposit address until one network is revealed: send the payer to `checkout_url`, where they pick a network and press "Generate payment", or reveal it yourself with `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/reveal` and show the address on your own page. Only revealed networks are watched. A session nobody reveals expires after the selection window (1 hour by default). A payment counts once it is confirmed (10 blocks on Base, `confirmed` on Solana); the session is paid when the counted sum equals the amount exactly. With `customer_address_id` the session opens on a customer address: it pays to the address's fixed deposit addresses and payout, takes the address's product (omit `product_id` or send the same), and while the address's latest session still waits for payment (`open` or `partially_paid`, not expired) that session is returned instead of a new one; once it is paid, overpaid, expired or otherwise closed, a new session opens on the same deposit addresses. Its customer already holds those addresses, so every network of such a session is revealed from creation and its pay window (`expires_in`) runs from creation. Funds sent to the address while no session was open are credited to the next session opened on it. On an `open` product, omitting `amount` there opens an open-amount session (`amount: null`): the first confirmed sum that settles after the fee pays it.

customer_address_id.description: An `active` customer address of the same mode (`caddr_` id): the session opens on it, or the address's latest session is returned while it still waits for payment (`open` or `partially_paid`, not expired).

expires_in.description: The pay window: how long the session stays open after its first reveal. 60 to 86,400 seconds. Default 1,800 (30 minutes).

post.description: Asks the scanner for one more check of a session it no longer watches: a session is watched until 23 hours after it expires (a server setting), and funds sent to its deposit address later are only found this way. The check reads the deposit addresses' balances and rescans their transfers; anything found is recorded as a late payment and sent to your webhooks as usual. Answers 202 with the session as it is now; the check runs in the background. Asking again while a check is queued answers 202 the same way and queues nothing more. Besides the key's `api_write` bucket it is limited to one check per session every 10 minutes and 30 per account (per mode) an hour. Takes no body. Audited as `session.recheck_requested`.

pay_to.description: One deposit address per network and asset, the same for every session. Funds are watched only while a session on the address is open.

payout.description: Snapshot of the product payout when the address was created, keyed by network. The addresses commit to it: a later payout, wallet or fee change reaches the customer only after a rotate.

metadata.description: Merged over the product metadata on every session of the address.

url.description: The address's hosted page for the customer.

created_at.description: When the address was created, RFC 3339 UTC.

rotated_at.description: When the address was rotated, RFC 3339 UTC; null while active.

next_cursor.description: Pass it back as `cursor`; null on the last page.
Pass it back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

ProductNetwork.description: How a product takes the stablecoins of one network it takes (D60). A network the product does not take is not listed.

chain.description: Network id, as in `payout`.

chain_name.description: The network name payers read (`Base`, `Solana devnet`).

accept.description: `all`: every stablecoin your account accepts on this network (Settings), including ones you turn on later. `some`: only `assets`; a listed stablecoin you turn off in Settings stays listed but is not offered until you turn it on again, and one you turn on later never joins by itself.

assets.description: `some` only: the stablecoin symbols the product takes on this network, in the network's order. Absent for `all`.

NetworkInput.description: A product's stablecoin choice on one network (D60).

accept.description: `all`: every stablecoin your account accepts on the network, including ones turned on later. `some`: only `assets`. `none`: the product does not take the network (its payout there is dropped, like `payout: {network: []}`).

assets.description: Required with `some` and refused otherwise: 1 or more distinct stablecoin symbols Prismaport offers on the network in this mode (`USDC`, `USDT`). A stablecoin you have turned off in Settings is accepted and stays stored; it is offered once you turn it on.

secretKey.description: `sk_test_…` or `sk_live_…`. Send it only from your server.
